environment: local current API with real OpenAI provider; isolated SQLite fixture identity

assertions.name: Create Main plus two side chats through real API/provider
Independent hosted sessions share one actual provider workspace
Foreign chat ownership denied before provider work
Global reset invalidates Main and both side chats
Eight same-chat HTTP requests share one refreshed provider session
Exactly one real provider creation per stale side chat
Different chats enter provider creation concurrently
Side refreshes leave Main session unchanged
Refreshed sides reuse the same workspace
Each side retains exactly one previous-session reference
Returned refreshed sessions are retrievable from real provider

limitations: This is local API/actual-provider evidence, not staging deployment or native/browser UI proof.
No remote application database, Storage, payment, email or SMS credentials were loaded.
Tool failure transport/persistence is covered separately by local regression tests.
SDK has no environment deletion operation; only smoke-created sessions are deleted, leaving the shared environment to provider-managed expiration.
